nodes.label: Pauli twirling / randomized compiling (MODIFIER)
nodes.rationale: Converts coherent to stochastic error without reducing average bias, so a standalone twirling candidate would cost compilation with no benefit; it raises strategy_confidence of ZNE/PEC instead.

nodes.label: Zero-noise extrapolation (digital gate folding)

nodes.label: Probabilistic error cancellation — overhead calculator only
